info.title: Windows Maintenance Manager API
info.description: The API of the console. Every write needs the X-WMM-Token header of the console or, with accounts on, an API token (Settings › API tokens) sent as Authorization: Bearer wmm_…. With accounts on, x-permissions lists what the role of the user (or the scopes of the token) must include. Runs of tools are also checked tool by tool.

get.summary: Optional filters: area, kind (fix/report), risk and q (text in title, description or id).
